label: PGMaps Index Lab Indicator Catalog
description: Research-backed, source-ready indicator definitions for building Prince George neighbourhood exposure, vulnerability, and resilience indexes.
defaultGeographies: City of Prince George service-area buffer
BC Ministry of Health local health area

indicators.label: Annual mean fine particulate matter (PM2.5)
indicators.unit: micrograms per cubic metre
indicators.source: PGMaps monitor network files, BC ENV stations, EPA monitor products, SPARTAN, ASCENT, and near-term CANUE annual PM2.5 surfaces
indicators.geography: monitor point interpolated or area-weighted to dissemination area/block
indicators.year: latest available annual average, with historical annual series when available
indicators.citation: World Health Organization. WHO global air quality guidelines: particulate matter, ozone, nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide and carbon monoxide. 2021. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240034228/; CANUE data platform: https://www.canuedata.ca/
indicators.processingNotes: Prefer annual monitor-validated surfaces. If only monitors are available, summarize nearest-monitor, inverse-distance, or kriged estimates with monitor count and distance diagnostics.
indicators.limitations: Sparse monitors can miss street-scale variation, wildfire smoke episodes, and indoor exposure; CANUE access may have licensing constraints.

indicators.label: Wildfire smoke exposure days
indicators.unit: days per year above smoke/PM2.5 threshold
indicators.source: BC ENV monitors, low-cost sensors, satellite aerosol products, FireWork/BlueSky forecasts, and BC Wildfire Service fire activity feeds
indicators.citation: Health Canada. Wildfire smoke and your health. https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/publications/healthy-living/wildfire-smoke-health.html; BC Wildfire Service data catalogue/API documentation. https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/safety/wildfire-status
indicators.processingNotes: Count days where daily PM2.5 exceeds a project threshold during known smoke periods; keep threshold configurable for AQHI or WHO-aligned analysis.
indicators.limitations: Attribution of PM2.5 to wildfire smoke requires smoke-plume or chemical-context evidence; monitors may not represent neighbourhood-scale smoke gradients.

indicators.label: Annual mean nitrogen dioxide (NO2)
indicators.unit: parts per billion or micrograms per cubic metre
indicators.source: Near-term CANUE NO2 surfaces, TROPOMI grids, and road-proximity proxies
indicators.citation: World Health Organization. WHO global air quality guidelines. 2021. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240034228/; CANUE data sets summary, Population Data BC. https://www.popdata.bc.ca/data/environment/canue
indicators.processingNotes: Use modeled annual NO2 where available; otherwise flag as proxy if estimated from traffic corridors or TROPOMI coarse grids.
indicators.limitations: Satellite pixels are coarse for neighbourhood analysis and winter cloud/snow conditions can reduce retrieval quality.

indicators.label: Population near high-traffic corridors
indicators.unit: percent of residents within 100 metres
indicators.source: City of Prince George road centreline/open data and provincial highway network
indicators.citation: Health Effects Institute. Traffic-related air pollution: a critical review of the literature on emissions, exposure, and health effects. 2010. https://www.healtheffects.org/publication/traffic-related-air-pollution-critical-review-literature-emissions-exposure-and-health-effects
indicators.processingNotes: Classify highways/arterials as high-traffic until traffic counts are available; intersect residential population-weighted centroids or dasymetric residential parcels with buffers.
indicators.limitations: Road class is a proxy; exposure depends on traffic volume, fleet mix, grade, wind, and time spent at home.

indicators.label: Very hot days
indicators.unit: days per year with maximum temperature at or above 30 C
indicators.source: Environment and Climate Change Canada weather stations, gridded climate normals, and near-term downscaled climate projections
indicators.geography: 1 km grid summarized to dissemination area/block
indicators.year: latest 30-year normal and annual observed series
indicators.citation: Health Canada. Adapting to extreme heat events: guidelines for assessing health vulnerability. 2011. https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/environmental-workplace-health/reports-publications/climate-change-health/adapting-extreme-heat-events-guidelines-assessing-health-vulnerability-health-canada-2011.html
indicators.processingNotes: Summarize observed and normal-period days; keep baseline and projection scenario metadata alongside values.
indicators.limitations: Weather-station data understate intra-urban heat; gridded products may smooth valley, slope, and land-cover effects.

indicators.label: Surface urban heat island intensity
indicators.unit: degrees Celsius above rural reference
indicators.source: Landsat land surface temperature, MODIS land surface temperature, NDVI, impervious surface, and local climate zones
indicators.geography: 30 m to 1 km grid summarized to dissemination area/block
indicators.year: summer season composite, latest cloud-free years
indicators.citation: Health Canada. Reducing urban heat islands to protect health in Canada. 2020. https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health/publications/healthy-living/reducing-urban-heat-islands-protect-health-canada.html; Statistics Canada. Urban greenness, 2001, 2011 and 2019. https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/pub/16-002-x/2021001/article/00002-eng.htm
indicators.processingNotes: Create summer daytime LST composites and compare each cell to a rural/forested reference around Prince George.
indicators.limitations: Satellite land surface temperature is not air temperature and is sensitive to overpass time, cloud masking, and surface moisture.

indicators.label: Flood susceptibility
indicators.unit: index or percent of land in elevated susceptibility zone
indicators.source: Natural Resources Canada Flood Susceptibility Index, floodplain mapping, LiDAR-derived terrain, and local hydrology layers
indicators.geography: parcel, dissemination block, or dissemination area
indicators.citation: Natural Resources Canada. Data related to flood mapping. https://natural-resources.canada.ca/science-and-data/science-and-research/natural-hazards/data-related-flood-mapping/24250
indicators.processingNotes: Overlay parcels or residential land with flood susceptibility classes; calculate exposed area and exposed residential units where parcels are available.
indicators.limitations: National susceptibility is screening-level and should not replace engineered floodplain mapping or site-specific depth/velocity modelling.

indicators.label: Wildland-urban interface exposure
indicators.unit: percent of homes or land in WUI buffer
indicators.source: BC Wildfire Service fuel/threat layers, forest cover, building footprints/parcels, and municipal boundaries
indicators.geography: parcel, dissemination block, or dissemination area
indicators.year: latest available fuel and parcel layers
indicators.citation: BC Wildfire Service. Wildfire data and tools. https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/safety/wildfire-status; Canadian Council of Forest Ministers. Canadian Wildland Fire Strategy. https://www.ccfm.org/
indicators.processingNotes: Classify parcels/buildings within interface/intermix buffers around forested or high-fuel areas; summarize residential counts and population.
indicators.limitations: Interface exposure does not represent structure ignition risk unless defensible space, building materials, slope, wind, and suppression access are included.

indicators.label: Older adults
indicators.unit: percent of population age 65 and older
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census age profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Census Profile, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/dp-pd/prof/index.cfm; Health Canada extreme heat vulnerability guidelines. https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/environmental-workplace-health/reports-publications/climate-change-health/adapting-extreme-heat-events-guidelines-assessing-health-vulnerability-health-canada-2011.html
indicators.processingNotes: Divide residents age 65+ by total population; use census rounding-aware calculations and suppress unstable small denominators.
indicators.limitations: Age is a sensitivity proxy and does not identify individual health status, social isolation, or air-conditioning access.

indicators.label: Young children
indicators.unit: percent of population under age 5
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census age profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Census Profile, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/dp-pd/prof/index.cfm; World Health Organization. Protecting health from climate change vulnerability and adaptation assessment. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241564687
indicators.processingNotes: Divide residents age 0-4 by total population; consider school/care-facility daytime population as a separate future layer.
indicators.limitations: Residential census data does not capture daytime childcare locations or household-level caregiver capacity.

indicators.label: Low-income residents
indicators.unit: percent of residents in low income after tax
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census income profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Dictionary, Census of Population, 2021: low-income measure after tax. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/ref/dict/index-eng.cfm
indicators.processingNotes: Use LIM-AT counts divided by population in private households where available; flag income-reference-year differences.
indicators.limitations: Census income predates later inflation and housing-cost shocks; small-area values are rounded and may be suppressed.

indicators.label: Indigenous identity population
indicators.unit: percent of residents reporting Indigenous identity
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census Indigenous identity profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Indigenous peoples and housing in Canada: Census of Population, 2021. https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/220921/dq220921a-eng.htm
indicators.processingNotes: Use only for equity-screening and engagement planning; avoid ranking communities without Indigenous governance review.
indicators.limitations: This is not a deficit measure. It can reflect colonial exposure and service inequities but must be interpreted with Indigenous data sovereignty principles.

indicators.label: Lone-parent families
indicators.unit: percent of census families that are lone-parent families
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census families profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Census Profile, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/dp-pd/prof/index.cfm
indicators.processingNotes: Divide lone-parent census families by total census families; suppress very small denominators.
indicators.limitations: Family structure does not directly measure caregiving load, income, or informal support networks.

indicators.label: Transit stop access
indicators.unit: percent of residents within 400 metres of a transit stop
indicators.source: BC Transit/City of Prince George GTFS or stop inventory
indicators.citation: Canadian Urban Environmental Health Research Consortium protocol includes transportation and neighbourhood factors for health research. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29310629/
indicators.processingNotes: Buffer active stops by walking-network distance where network data exists; otherwise use straight-line 400 m screening buffers.
indicators.limitations: Stop proximity does not capture frequency, reliability, fare affordability, accessibility, snow clearance, or destinations reachable.

indicators.label: Cooling centre and public indoor refuge access
indicators.unit: percent of residents within 800 metres or 15-minute transit trip
indicators.source: City of Prince George facilities, libraries, community centres, malls, and emergency cooling-centre listings
indicators.citation: Health Canada. Communicating the health risks of extreme heat events: toolkit for public health and emergency management officials. https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/environmental-workplace-health/reports-publications/climate-change-health/communicating-health-risks-extreme-heat-events-toolkit-public-health-emergency-management-officials-health-canada-2011.html
indicators.processingNotes: Maintain facility type, seasonal hours, accessibility, and whether the site is activated only during alerts.
indicators.limitations: Access estimates can overstate usable refuge if hours, capacity, disability access, or transport barriers are missing.

indicators.label: Car-dependent commuters
indicators.unit: percent of commuters using car, truck, or van
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census commute mode profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Census Profile, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/dp-pd/prof/index.cfm
indicators.processingNotes: Use commute mode shares for workers with a usual place of work; pair with transit and active-mobility access metrics.
indicators.limitations: Commute mode excludes non-work trips and was affected by pandemic-era work patterns.

indicators.label: Tree canopy and greenness
indicators.unit: percent canopy or mean NDVI
indicators.source: NDVI from Landsat/MODIS/Sentinel, municipal tree canopy data, and near-term CANUE greenness datasets
indicators.geography: 30 m grid, parcel, dissemination block, or dissemination area
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Urban greenness, 2001, 2011 and 2019. https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/pub/16-002-x/2021001/article/00002-eng.htm; CANUE data sets summary. https://www.popdata.bc.ca/data/environment/canue
indicators.processingNotes: Use growing-season median NDVI; if canopy polygons are available, report canopy separately from grass/shrub greenness.
indicators.limitations: NDVI can confuse irrigated grass with shade trees and does not measure public accessibility.

indicators.label: Nearby park access
indicators.unit: percent of residents within 400 metres of a public park
indicators.source: City of Prince George parks/open-space polygons and trails
indicators.citation: World Health Organization Regional Office for Europe. Urban green spaces and health: a review of evidence. 2016. https://www.who.int/europe/publications/i/item/WHO-EURO-2016-3352-43111-60341
indicators.processingNotes: Use walk-network distance where available; classify parks by size, shade, water access, seating, and washrooms when attributes exist.
indicators.limitations: Distance alone misses park quality, safety, programming, shade, slope, snow clearance, and accessibility.

indicators.label: Impervious surface coverage
indicators.unit: percent of land area
indicators.source: Land-cover classification, building footprints, roads, parking lots, parcels, and satellite imagery
indicators.geography: parcel, dissemination block, or dissemination area
indicators.citation: Health Canada. Reducing urban heat islands to protect health in Canada. https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health/publications/healthy-living/reducing-urban-heat-islands-protect-health-canada.html
indicators.processingNotes: Combine building footprint, road, and classified paved-surface layers; summarize only land area, excluding water.
indicators.limitations: Automated classifications need local validation and may miss gravel, shaded pavement, or small parking areas.

indicators.label: Healthy food retail access
indicators.unit: percent of residents within 1 km walking distance of grocery or market
indicators.source: City business licences, OpenStreetMap, provincial food premises listings, and local food asset inventories
indicators.citation: BC Centre for Disease Control. Food security indicator framework for British Columbia. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35184582/
indicators.processingNotes: Classify full-service grocery, market, convenience, emergency food, and prepared-food sites separately; compute network distance.
indicators.limitations: Proximity does not measure price, cultural appropriateness, opening hours, food quality, or household purchasing power.

indicators.label: Food insecurity risk proxy
indicators.unit: index percentile
indicators.source: Statistics Canada income, rent burden, household composition, and BCCDC food security indicator framework
indicators.year: 2021 Census plus latest local food asset data
indicators.citation: BC Centre for Disease Control. Priority health equity indicators for British Columbia: household food insecurity update report. 2023. https://www.bccdc.ca/our-services/programs/food-security
indicators.processingNotes: Build as a transparent composite of low income, unaffordable housing, lone-parent households, and grocery access; keep component values visible.
indicators.limitations: Household food insecurity is income-driven and not directly measured in the census at small geographies.

indicators.label: Food premises with recent high-risk inspection findings
indicators.unit: premises per 1,000 residents or percent of inspected premises
indicators.source: Northern Health or provincial health authority food premises inspection reports, where accessible
indicators.citation: Province of British Columbia. Food safety evidence review for core public health functions. https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/health/about-bc-s-health-care-system/public-health/environmental-health/food_safety_evidence_review.pdf
indicators.processingNotes: Geocode inspected premises and aggregate critical/high-risk violations by inspection date; separate inspection coverage from violation rate.
indicators.limitations: Inspection frequency is risk-based and complaint-driven, so raw counts can reflect monitoring intensity rather than unsafe food environments.

indicators.label: School catchment heat exposure
indicators.unit: mean summer land surface temperature or heat percentile
indicators.source: CityPG elementary and secondary school catchments, school locations, Landsat/MODIS heat layers, and census children counts
indicators.year: latest school catchment and heat composite
indicators.citation: Health Canada. Reducing urban heat islands to protect health in Canada. https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health/publications/healthy-living/reducing-urban-heat-islands-protect-health-canada.html
indicators.processingNotes: Summarize heat and greenness inside catchments and within 400 m of school properties; weight by children where possible.
indicators.limitations: Catchments do not equal actual enrolment boundaries for all programs and do not capture indoor cooling or school-day schedules.

indicators.label: Active route connectivity to schools
indicators.unit: index or percent of homes within 1.6 km connected by sidewalk/path network
indicators.source: City sidewalk/trail/bikeway network, road centreline, school locations, and school catchments
indicators.citation: Public Health Agency of Canada. Designing healthy living. https://www.canada.ca/en/public-health/services/health-promotion/healthy-living/physical-activity/designing-healthy-living.html; CANUE protocol. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29310629/
indicators.processingNotes: Compute low-stress walking/cycling routes to school entrances; include crossings and arterial barriers when data exists.
indicators.limitations: Network presence does not measure traffic speed, winter maintenance, perceived safety, lighting, or bike parking.

indicators.label: Renter households
indicators.unit: percent of private households renting
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census households profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Census Profile, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/dp-pd/prof/index.cfm
indicators.processingNotes: Divide tenant households by total private households; combine with income, age, and climate hazard indicators for vulnerability screens.
indicators.limitations: Tenure is a proxy for housing insecurity and adaptation control; it does not measure landlord responsiveness or lease protections.

indicators.label: Households spending 30 percent or more of income on shelter
indicators.unit: percent of households
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census housing profile, existing PGMaps census variables
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Housing suitability, adequacy and affordability, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/ref/dict/az/Definition-eng.cfm?ID=households-menage029
indicators.processingNotes: Use census shelter-cost-to-income threshold; keep owner and renter burden separate when available.
indicators.limitations: Does not capture utility arrears, hidden homelessness, quality problems below census thresholds, or post-2021 rent changes.

indicators.label: Older housing stock
indicators.unit: percent of occupied dwellings built before 1980
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census dwelling period of construction and BC Assessment parcel/building year where licensed
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Census Profile, 2021 Census. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/dp-pd/prof/index.cfm; BC Assessment Data Advice product information. https://info.bcassessment.ca/services-and-products/government/local-government/Pages/Data-Advice.aspx
indicators.processingNotes: Use census period of construction for public small-area summaries; use parcel-level building year only if licensing permits.
indicators.limitations: Older dwellings are a proxy for energy efficiency and repair needs; renovations, heating systems, and air filtration are not captured.

indicators.label: Residential assessed value intensity
indicators.unit: Canadian dollars per square metre of parcel or floor area
indicators.source: BC Assessment parcel and assessment data, where licensed; existing PGMaps parcel layer for geometry only
indicators.citation: BC Assessment. Data Advice bulk assessment information. https://info.bcassessment.ca/services-and-products/government/local-government/Pages/Data-Advice.aspx
indicators.processingNotes: Aggregate only public or licensed fields; separate land and improvement value if available; normalize by parcel or dwelling size.
indicators.limitations: Assessment value is not affordability, displacement risk, or market rent; data licensing and privacy constraints may limit public release.

indicators.label: Reported road collision density
indicators.unit: collisions per kilometre of road or per 1,000 residents
indicators.source: ICBC open crash data, BC Ministry of Transportation collision systems, and municipal road network
indicators.geography: road segment, school catchment, dissemination area/block
indicators.citation: Province of British Columbia. Collision Information System. https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/transportation/transportation-infrastructure/engineering-standards-guidelines/collision-information-system
indicators.processingNotes: Use multi-year averages and severity weighting; normalize by road length, residents, or estimated exposure depending on use case.
indicators.limitations: Reported collisions miss near-misses and underreported minor incidents; spatial precision may be limited for privacy.

indicators.label: Police-reported crime severity context
indicators.unit: Crime Severity Index or rate per 100,000 population
indicators.source: Statistics Canada Uniform Crime Reporting Survey and local police service open data if available
indicators.geography: municipality, police service area, or neighbourhood where available
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Police-reported crime statistics in Canada, 2024. https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/250722/dq250722a-eng.htm; Uniform Crime Reporting Survey. https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/survey/business/3302
indicators.processingNotes: Use CSI for broad municipal context and local point/incident data only if privacy-protected and consistently geocoded.
indicators.limitations: Police-reported data reflects reporting practices, enforcement, and geocoding policy; it should not be used to stigmatize neighbourhoods.

indicators.label: Pedestrian lighting gap proxy
indicators.unit: percent of sidewalk/path length without nearby streetlight
indicators.source: Municipal streetlight inventory, sidewalk/trail network, and road centreline data
indicators.geography: road segment, school catchment, dissemination area/block
indicators.citation: Public Health Agency of Canada. Built environment and active transportation guidance. https://www.canada.ca/en/public-health/services/health-promotion/healthy-living/physical-activity/designing-healthy-living.html
indicators.processingNotes: Buffer streetlights against pedestrian network; flag gaps on school routes, transit walksheds, and park access routes.
indicators.limitations: Infrastructure records may be incomplete; lighting quality, outages, vegetation blockage, and perceived safety require field validation.

indicators.label: Distance to nearest regulatory air monitor
indicators.unit: kilometres
indicators.source: PGMaps public/data/monitors.csv, public/data/bc/bc_air_monitoring_stations.csv, EPA, ASCENT, SPARTAN, and low-cost sensor inventories
indicators.geography: dissemination area/block centroid or grid cell
indicators.citation: World Health Organization. WHO global air quality guidelines. 2021. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240034228/; PGMaps monitor manifests in public/data/manifest.json
indicators.processingNotes: Compute nearest active monitor distance by pollutant/network; include active/inactive status and pollutants measured.
indicators.limitations: Nearest distance does not guarantee representative siting, data completeness, or coverage of relevant pollutants.

indicators.label: Satellite observation coverage
indicators.unit: valid observations per year or percent of days observed
indicators.source: PGMaps public/data/satellite/coverage.json and TROPOMI gridded products
indicators.geography: grid cell summarized to dissemination area/block
indicators.citation: European Space Agency Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI mission information. https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/missions/sentinel-5p; PGMaps satellite coverage file public/data/satellite/coverage.json
indicators.processingNotes: Track valid retrieval counts after cloud/snow/quality filtering; summarize coverage separately from pollutant concentration.
indicators.limitations: High-latitude snow, clouds, terrain, and retrieval quality filters can create seasonal and spatial gaps.

indicators.label: Census small-area data quality flag
indicators.unit: quality flag
indicators.source: Statistics Canada 2021 Census geography attributes and PGMaps census variable files
indicators.citation: Statistics Canada. Guide to the Census of Population, 2021. https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/ref/98-304/index-eng.cfm
indicators.processingNotes: Expose suppression, null, rounding, and denominator-size flags for every indicator derived from census variables.
indicators.limitations: Quality flags describe statistical reliability, not whether the construct is valid for a specific policy decision.
